Sample.evidence_source: [/page/3/Text/3] Under these assumptions, 108 patients per treatment group (N=432) were needed to achieve 80% or greater power to detect a difference of .20 in response rates between any 2 treatment groups.

dxgive.evidence_source: [/page/3/Text/3] The primary end point used in the sample size estimate was treatment response rate, which was defined as a CGI improvement score of 1 (very much improved) or 2 (much improved), assigned by the independent evaluator.
dxgive.warning: The text mentions 'patients' and a 'CGI improvement score', which is a severity measure, but does not explicitly state that a formal diagnostic criterion was required for inclusion or assessed at baseline. It also does not exclude diagnosed individuals. Therefore, it defaults to 400.
